android.desc:
Calls Blacklist – Call Blocker helps you block unknown callers, private numbers, and numbers on your blacklist. Choose to block unknown incoming calls from numbers not saved in your contacts, while allowing calls from your contacts and numbers on your whitelist.

Set your own rules to block spam calls, robocalls, and calls from telemarketers. Switch between call blocking profiles for work, sleep, or personal time without changing each setting. No account is required to use this spam call blocker.

BLOCK UNKNOWN CALLS:
• Block unknown numbers that are not saved in your contacts
• Block private numbers (calls with a hidden caller ID)
• Choose to block all incoming calls
• Block incoming phone calls while a VoIP call is active

CALL BLOCKING PROFILES:
• Save different call blocking settings for work, sleep, or personal time
• Choose a blocking method and turn the whitelist on or off for each profile
• Choose which folders are active and set a schedule for each profile
• Switch profiles without changing each setting manually

WHITELIST:
• Allow calls from trusted numbers even when call blocking is enabled
• Add individual numbers or prefix rules to your whitelist

BLACKLIST & PREFIX RULES:
• Add unwanted numbers manually or from your contacts
• Block numbers that begin with specific digits, such as a prefix or area code
• Block numbers that contain specific digits anywhere in the number

NUMBER FOLDERS:
• Organize numbers into folders in both lists
• Turn folders on or off to manage groups of numbers

IMPORT & EXPORT:
• Import numbers into either list from TXT and CSV files
• Export numbers from either list to a TXT or CSV file

BLOCKING METHODS:
• Reject: decline the incoming call
• Ignore: block the call without rejecting it
• Mute: silence the ringtone

CALL BLOCKING SCHEDULE:
• Schedule call blocking by time of day and day of the week
• Set multiple blocking periods within the same day
• Set different blocking times for individual days of the week

CALL LOGS:
• View blocked calls in the app's log
• Keep a history of incoming calls on your device
• Add numbers from the log or local call history to either list

BACKUP:
• Back up your lists, rules, and app settings
• Restore your backup when reinstalling the app or switching devices
• Enable automatic daily backups and keep previous backups
